locked.featureBody: The active account's plan doesn't grant `can_invite_team`, so the ACL hides this form. In dev, grant the feature via `app.account_feature_overrides` (or seed the user on a plan that includes it). In production, this is the empty state your end users will see — replace the copy and CTA with whatever upgrade flow you ship.
locked.roleBody: The active membership is a viewer or member, and the ACL only grants `invite TeamMember` to owner and admin. Adjust the role grants in `apps/ui/src/lib/acl/ability.ts` (and its server mirror in `apps/api/src/lib/acl/ability.ts`) if you want other roles to invite.

banner.title: Cookies and your privacy
banner.body: We use a small set of essential cookies to keep you signed in. Analytics and marketing cookies stay off until you say otherwise.

configure.body: Toggle the categories you're comfortable with. Essential cookies stay on because the app can't sign you in without them. You can change this any time from settings.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: Authentication, language preference. Always on — the app cannot function without these.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: First-party product analytics: which pages get used, where users drop off. Never sent to a third party without your consent.

marketing.title: Marketing
